a young person kneeling at the thick roots of an old pagoda tree, digging a small sealed clay wine jar out of the dark soil with bare hands.
a small village girl squatting under a tree beside an herb basket taller than herself, holding up a torn scrap of paper with a puzzled face.

a dishevelled middle-aged swordsman sitting by a night campfire in a mountain hollow, hugging half of a broken sword, a wine gourd tipped beside him.
an old hermit in a faded washed-out Taoist robe waiting in a bamboo grove before a thatched hut, an old rolled scroll and a cup of tea on a low stone table.
a small heap-of-stones grave inside a shallow mountain cave with a blank weathered headstone, a bunch of long-dried wildflowers laid before it.
inside a small talisman shop with paper talismans hanging from strings, an old shopkeeper reading a letter with reddened eyes while a young traveller waits quietly at the counter.
a thin little girl kneeling at the door of a herbal medicine hall with her herb basket set beside her, a stern shopkeeper standing in the doorway with folded arms.
a crowd of angry creditors grabbing a very skinny man by the collar at a market entrance, curious onlookers gathering, an abacus dropped on the ground.
a poor thin scholar at a tiny stall against a market wall, copying talisman drafts with a brush, clutching one sheet with trembling hands.
a young girl with soot smudged on her face running out of an herbal medicine hall, proudly holding up one lumpy pill in her open palm, a faint wisp of furnace smoke behind her.
an old beggar huddled in a corner at the foot of a market wall, lifting cloudy eyes toward a passing cultivator, a cracked bowl beside him.
a crowd jostling around a street stone-gambling stall, the vendor sawing open a rough boulder to reveal a gleam of green jade inside, piles of uncut rocks.
a pawnshop with a high counter, a young mother holding a small child pleading with the pawnbroker, a sheathed sword lying on the counter, the child reaching out toward it.
a small thin old sect elder squatting in an herb garden pulling weeds, three wooden boxes set behind him, sect buildings on a mountain slope in the distance.
a lonely cloth bundle and a small crooked hand-sewn amulet pouch lying on a rock in a dark windswept valley, dead grass bending in the black wind.
a young woman and her older brother reunited by a campfire at night at the mouth of a dark valley, she pounds his chest with her fist, a fine sword laid beside the fire.
a sect examiner sitting cross-legged on a huge boulder at the mouth of a dark windswept valley, a single stick of incense burning before him, a tiny flag on a distant ridge.
a lean swordsman standing in a howling black wind inside a rocky valley, his re-forged sword showing a visible weld seam, cloak whipping behind him.
a maze of tall wind-eroded stone pillars in a dark valley, black wind swirling between them, one pillar marked with a crude carved arrow pointing deeper in.
a caravan of heavily laden pack beasts sneaking through a dark valley floor at night, bulging saddlebags leaking faint glints of light, a scarred escort with his hand on his saber.
a lone cultivator carving tiny marks into a vast wind-polished cliff wall in a sheltered corner of a deep gorge.
night on a misty marsh, a small pale child clinging to the side of a moored fishing boat in the moonlight, the water beneath him showing no reflection.
a long procession of eerie green lantern lights floating over a misty marsh at night, fishermen's stilt huts on the shore with doors and windows shut tight.
at midnight a procession of shrimp soldiers and crab warriors carrying a red bridal sedan chair across the surface of a marsh, banners and drums, reeds on the shore.
an old cultivator sitting on the upturned eave of an old bell tower standing in a marsh, striking a huge bronze bell, enormous willow roots coiled around the tower base under the water.
a mirror-flat small lake in a marsh, a cultivator standing at the shore, but the reflection in the water shows an old white-haired man sitting under house eaves surrounded by grandchildren.
a fog-locked immortal island in a cold northern sea with an ancient alchemy palace on it, a small white-bearded boy attendant dozing beside a huge bronze furnace at the gate.
a small white-haired boy attendant wiping a faint handprint on the body of an enormous ancient bronze alchemy furnace with an old cloth, glowing embers inside the furnace.
a cultivator stepping out of a cave on a rocky sea island, a pine tree beside the cave mouth grown thick and tall, an unfamiliar fishing village far down by the shore.
ten thousand ancient swords planted in deep snow on a mountain slope, hilts crusted with ice, a tall faceless figure formed of pale sword light rising from among them.
a weathered stone puppet in roughly human shape sweeping an endless flight of white jade stairs leading up to ruined immortal gates in falling snow.
an old man hunched over a tiny campfire in a blizzard on a high snowy mountain ledge, adding a dry twig to the weak flame.
a lone figure standing on the summit of a towering snow peak looking down at an endless sea of clouds, dark tribulation clouds gathering on the far horizon.
a radiant golden lotus sprouting from a white jade altar amid ruined immortal palace terraces, faint glowing light rising, snowy peaks behind.
